completion_text.zh:
长桌上方的烛火轻轻摇曳，你第一次以霍格沃茨学生的身份坐在人群之中。

【分院之夜 · 完成】
明天第一堂魔咒课正在等你。学会漂浮咒后，就能开始自主探索校园。
completion_text.en:
Candles tremble above the long tables as you take your place among the students of Hogwarts for the first time.

[SORTING NIGHT COMPLETE]
Your first Charms lesson awaits. Master the Levitation Charm, then explore the campus freely.

narration.zh: 新生们沿着湿润的石阶走到湖边。薄雾贴着黑色水面流动，一排小船静静等在岸旁。远处的城堡占据整片夜空，塔楼窗户像被风吹散的星光。
narration.en: The first-years follow damp stone steps to the lakeshore. Mist drifts across the black water, where a row of small boats waits in silence. The castle fills the night ahead, its tower windows like stars scattered by the wind.

revisit_narration.zh: 最后几艘小船仍停在湖边，城堡的倒影在水面上轻轻破碎。
revisit_narration.en: The last few boats still wait at the shore, the castle reflection breaking softly across the water.

text.zh: “每条船不要超过四个人！手脚留在船里，也别试着摸水里的东西。”
text.en: “No more than four to a boat! Keep your hands inside, and do not try to touch anything in the water.”

text.zh: “我替你留了位置。经历过那只箱子和一整列火车以后，一条小船应该难不倒我们。”
text.en: “I saved you a place. After that trunk and an entire train, one small boat should not defeat us.”

text.zh: “又见面了。要一起坐吗？至少在分院以前，船不会问我们属于哪里。”
text.en: “There you are again. Shall we share a boat? At least the boat will not ask where we belong before the Sorting does.”

text.zh: “这里还有一个位置。我叫罗温——看来现在才正式认识也不算太晚。”
text.en: “There is one place left here. I'm Rowan—I suppose the lake is not too late for a proper introduction.”

label.en: Board a boat and cross the lake

player_text.zh: 你踏进轻轻摇晃的小船，在罗温身边坐下。
player_text.en: You step into the gently rocking boat and sit beside Rowan.

text.zh: 船队无声地离开岸边。城堡越来越近，直到高耸的石墙遮住了整片天空。
text.en: The boats glide soundlessly away from shore. The castle grows until its stone walls seem to cover the entire sky.

narration.zh: 橡木大门在身后合拢，火把照亮高得看不见尽头的石墙。礼堂另一侧传来数百人的交谈声，新生们不约而同地安静下来。
narration.en: The oak doors close behind you, and torchlight climbs stone walls too high to follow. Hundreds of voices murmur beyond the Great Hall doors, and the first-years fall quiet together.

revisit_narration.zh: 礼堂中的声音一阵阵穿过门板，队伍又向前挪动了一小步。
revisit_narration.en: Waves of voices pass through the doors as the line inches forward once more.

text.zh: “等候期间请保持安静。分院结束后，你们的学院将成为在校期间的家。”
text.en: “Please remain quiet while you wait. After the Sorting, your house will be your home during your years at Hogwarts.”

text.zh: 罗温压低声音：“如果那顶帽子也像我的箱子那么固执，你还愿意再帮我一次吗？”
text.en: Rowan whispers, “If the hat is as stubborn as my trunk, would you help me defeat it too?”

label.en: Follow the line into the Great Hall

player_text.zh: 你的名字即将被念到。你跟随新生队伍走进礼堂。
player_text.en: Your name will be called soon. You follow the first-years into the Great Hall.

text.zh: 礼堂大门向内打开。漂浮的蜡烛一直延伸到被施过魔法的夜空之下，一张矮凳和一顶旧尖帽正等在所有目光中央。
text.en: The doors open inward. Floating candles stretch beneath an enchanted night sky, while a small stool and an ancient pointed hat wait beneath every watching eye.

narration.zh: 副校长念出你的名字。礼堂里的声音忽然消失，只剩长桌两侧无数张面孔和矮凳上的旧帽子。
narration.en: The Deputy Head calls your name. Every voice in the hall disappears, leaving only hundreds of faces and the old hat upon its stool.

revisit_narration.zh: 矮凳仍在礼堂中央等待，分院帽的帽檐微微弯起，仿佛早已看见了你的答案。
revisit_narration.en: The stool still waits at the centre of the hall. The Sorting Hat's brim curls slightly, as though it has already seen your answer.

text.en: “Take your seat and put on the Sorting Hat.”

player_text.zh: 你坐上矮凳，把分院帽戴到头上。
player_text.en: You sit upon the stool and lower the Sorting Hat onto your head.

text.zh: “你会害怕，但不会让害怕替你决定方向。愿意先迈出那一步的人——格兰芬多！”
text.en: “You will know fear, but you will not let it choose your direction. One who steps forward first—GRYFFINDOR!”

player_text.zh: 你坐上矮凳，把分院帽戴到头上。
player_text.en: You sit upon the stool and lower the Sorting Hat onto your head.

text.zh: “你看得见目标，也懂得选择抵达它的道路。把野心变成能力吧——斯莱特林！”
text.en: “You see the destination, and you understand how paths are chosen. Turn ambition into ability—SLYTHERIN!”

player_text.zh: 你坐上矮凳，把分院帽戴到头上。
player_text.en: You sit upon the stool and lower the Sorting Hat onto your head.

text.zh: “答案从不会让你满足，因为你总会发现下一个问题。让好奇心带你飞翔——拉文克劳！”
text.en: “An answer will never satisfy you for long, because another question always follows. Let curiosity give you wings—RAVENCLAW!”

player_text.zh: 你坐上矮凳，把分院帽戴到头上。
player_text.en: You sit upon the stool and lower the Sorting Hat onto your head.

text.zh: “你愿意留下，愿意倾听，也愿意把艰难的事情做到最后。忠诚会成为你的力量——赫奇帕奇！”
text.en: “You stay, you listen, and you finish what is difficult. Loyalty will become your strength—HUFFLEPUFF!”

narration.zh: 掌声从一张长桌旁响起。你摘下分院帽，穿过烛光和注视，走向从今以后属于自己的位置。
narration.en: Applause rises from one of the long tables. You remove the hat and cross the candlelight towards the place that will now be yours.

revisit_narration.zh: 学院长桌旁仍有人为新同学腾出位置，金色餐盘映着上方漂浮的烛火。
revisit_narration.en: Students still make room along the house table, while golden plates reflect the candles floating overhead.

text.zh: 格兰芬多长桌爆发出欢呼，红金色的领带在人群中格外明亮。
text.en: The Gryffindor table erupts in cheers, red-and-gold ties bright among the crowd.

text.zh: 斯莱特林长桌响起整齐的掌声，银绿色在烛光下泛着冷静的光泽。
text.en: Measured applause rises from the Slytherin table, silver and green gleaming beneath the candles.

text.zh: 拉文克劳长桌的人们向两侧挪开，蓝铜色之间有人举起一本书向你致意。
text.en: Students at the Ravenclaw table make room, and someone among the blue and bronze raises a book in greeting.

text.zh: 赫奇帕奇长桌传来最热烈的欢迎，黄黑色的人群已经为你留好座位。
text.en: The warmest welcome comes from the Hufflepuff table, where the yellow-and-black crowd has already saved you a seat.

text.zh: 罗温隔着人群向你挥手：“明天早餐见。别忘了我们的楼梯约定！”
text.en: Rowan waves across the hall. “Breakfast tomorrow. Do not forget our staircase agreement!”

label.en: Take your place at the house table

player_text.zh: 你在新同学为你留出的位置坐下，抬头望向礼堂上空的星夜。
player_text.en: You sit in the space your new classmates have made and look up at the starlit ceiling.

text.zh: 分院结果和 NPC 记忆已经保存。接下来前往第一堂魔咒课。
text.en: Your Sorting result and NPC memories are saved. Your first Charms lesson begins next.
